finalText:
Repeat suppression is in, keyed off `event.key` in `state.lastSentAt`.

Replay: 0 errors, 99 dropped — exactly the 99 flap events `events.js` generates (each fires 2 minutes after its predecessor with the same key). Spot-check confirms the pattern: `evt-0017` pages at 271, `evt-0018` drops at 273.

Two decisions I made:
- Only an actual delivery starts the window. A dropped repeat doesn't refresh the timestamp, so a key firing every 2 minutes gets through once every 5+ minutes rather than being suppressed forever.
- A repeat is dropped when strictly less than 5 minutes has elapsed; one arriving at exactly 5 minutes sends. Flip `<` to `<=` in `REPEAT_WINDOW`'s comparison if you want the other boundary.

`createState()` now returns `{ lastSentAt: new Map() }` — anything constructing state by hand rather than calling `createState()` will need updating.
